content: Obesity is a risk factor for the development of several cancers, including breast, colon, and gynecologic carcinomas. Recent studies have shown that obesity not only correlates with carcinogenesis but also influences the prognosis of various cancer patients. For instance, obesity has been linked to a poor prognosis in breast and colon cancers, while favorable prognoses have been reported in obese patients with gastric or renal cancers.
